title: Skyline camera
intro: Keep this phone on a charger, with this page in front. Capture runs every 10 minutes in daylight.
preview: Masked camera preview. The lower third stays black.
regionsHelp: Enter each rectangle as percentages of the full frame. Keep it above the black lower third. Or choose a region, then tap the preview to place a 10% square.
tapReady: Tap the preview to place {region}. Number fields provide the keyboard path.
referenceSaved: Clear-day reference saved on this phone. Do not recapture it during probation.
referenceNeeded: No clear-day reference yet. Set both regions, then capture one.
consent: Send masked frames and measurements to this project.
privacy: The token, regions and masked reference stay on this phone. Only masked frames leave it. Frames are stored in Singapore. Protect access to this phone.
saved: Setup saved. Keep this page in front for the next daylight mark.
emptyQueue: No frames queued. Complete setup and keep this page in front for the next daylight mark.
permissionDenied: Camera off: permission denied. Allow camera in Chrome settings, then reload.
unsupported: Camera not supported here. Use Chrome on Android, or Safari on iOS 16.4 or later.
captureError: Camera frame failed. Keep this page in front, then tap Allow camera again.
wakeReleased: Screen lock released: keep this page in front, then tap to hold the screen on.
tokenRejected: Token rejected: paste a new device token.
posted: Posted {time} · far {ratio_far} · near {ratio_near} · {s} s round trip
dropped: Frame dropped · HTTP 422 · {reason}. The next frame is sent on schedule; if this repeats, capture a new reference.
invalid: Some fields need attention. Fix the ones marked above, then save.
errToken: Paste the device token for this camera.
errDistance: Enter a distance greater than 0 km.
errHours: Daylight must start before it ends.
errRegion: Keep this region inside the frame, above the black lower third.
errReference: Capture a clear-day reference before starting.
errConsent: Tick this box to start sending.
invalidReference: Reference needs contrast in both regions. Choose a landmark and a skyline with light and dark detail, then capture again.
storageError: Phone storage failed. Free space and reload. Capture is paused until frames can be saved.
offlineUnavailable: Offline reload is unavailable. Keep a connection and reload to try again.
loading: Loading camera setup from this phone…
